matchedRules.reason: Workspace facade and manifest changes must prove typed tool input contracts.
Current OS Trace gateway and Trace Burn changes must prove authenticated history paging, canonical TraceStore resolution, safe redaction, and OS-owned virtual-list/browser behavior.

Lifecycle updater, managed ingress dependency convergence, Caddy topology reload decisions, immutable release handoff, worker drain/load-balancer evacuation, detached activation, platform restart, and discoverable lifecycle-tool changes must run the exact lifecycle/facade/tool contracts without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

Internal workspace shell, Sites root, and trace/config chrome changes must prove the workspace root always converges on Home across daemon refreshes, the shared route switcher stays consistent, disabled agent surfaces remain re-enableable, and syntax stays valid. These tests share process.env and local MCP daemons, so files run serially to prevent cross-file agent-verification interference.
Session constructor, canonical guidance, task-start compatibility, and workspace fallback changes must prove the integrated task/work session contract.
